name: Downtown Summerlin
summary: Stylish, modern development with clothing & lifestyle stores, restaurants & the Las Vegas Ballpark.
demographics: Downtown Summerlin attracts an affluent, educated demographic from the surrounding Summerlin master-planned community, with visitors typically representing upper-middle to high-income households with median incomes exceeding $100,000. The primary trade area consists of families and active adults aged 35-65, many residing in the age-qualified villages within Summerlin, alongside young professionals drawn to the urban live-work-play environment. Shoppers at this center tend to be lifestyle-focused consumers who value quality dining experiences, entertainment options, and upscale retail offerings, with strong preferences for experiential shopping rather than purely transactional visits. The center's proximity to premium residential communities and its integration with professional sports venues positions it as a destination for both daily convenience and special occasion visits from throughout the Las Vegas metropolitan area.
description: Downtown Summerlin is a vibrant, walkable urban center that serves as the beating heart of the master-planned Summerlin community in Las Vegas. Described as a lifestyle and entertainment hub, this open-air destination seamlessly blends world-class shopping, diverse dining experiences, and premier entertainment venues into one cohesive experience. The center is home to major attractions including the Las Vegas Ballpark, where professional baseball comes alive, and City National Arena, the practice facility of the NHL's Vegas Golden Knights. With its mix of both homegrown and internationally recognized retailers and restaurants, Downtown Summerlin offers something for everyone, from casual shoppers to dedicated sports fans. The center's design emphasizes walkability and community engagement, featuring indoor and outdoor venues that host regular events, creating a dynamic atmosphere where residents and visitors can shop, dine, play, live, and work all in one place.
